item.text: The 26% candidate passed both stiffness checks, with guarded lower bounds of 12.97 GPa for Young’s modulus and 10.53 GPa for shear modulus. Its density remains unresolved because the error bound extends slightly above 26%. I’ll certify a 25.5% version to provide room below the density cap.

The first certificate also found that the 26% candidate could fail after an erosion offset of 1% of the cell size. That limits its manufacturing tolerance; I’ll report the tolerance result alongside the revised design’s certificate.
